title: Shraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the Division of the Threefold Faith
summary: Krishna explains that humans have three types of faith—Sattvic, Rajasic, or Tamasic—which influence their eating habits, sacrifices, austerities, and charities.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत |
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः || ३ ||
verses.translation: According to one's existence under the various modes of nature, one evolves a particular kind of faith. The living being is said to be of a particular faith according to the modes he has acquired.
verses.transliteration:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata
śraddhā-mayo ’yaṁ puruṣo yo yac-chraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
verses.meaning: Sattva-anurupa - according to the modes of goodness; Sarvasya - of all...
